record_scope: Checked omission/identity/inheritance mechanism and narrow optional native-select focus adapter; real UI portfolio remains failed/incomplete.

changes: Maintain 75 stable feedback IDs with falsifying and nearby-valid cases, retaining conditional defects, optional wants and tentative/project scope.

Classify the full catalog once per acceptance contract and inherit commitments through revisions; reject omitted cases, invalid feature tags, stale context/build, missing rendered evidence and invalid measurement links.
Make selector guidance available before implementing native/custom dropdowns; actual pointer feedback is separate from keyboard/programmatic/high-contrast focus and painted indicator balance.
Provide a tested optional native-select modality adapter while preferring suitable existing primitives.
Require phone contents access from the middle/bottom of actual reading, not only expanded attributes or scroll-zero tests.
Keep generated assets and expressive motion conditional on usefulness and selection; preserve original SVG/existing-asset alternatives.

findings.resolution: Same validity checks during plan and verification; mutation tests pass

findings.issue: Stale pointer target could hide later programmatic restoration
findings.resolution: Pointer marker expires/clears on blur; event tests and real restoration replay pass

parent_browser.selector: Trusted pointer trigger suppressed authored halo despite focus-visible matching. Tab/native ArrowDown, programmatic restoration, disabled/text-entry countercases, 320px render and forced-colors emulation checked. Native-popup pixels unverified.
parent_browser.reader: Desktop Contents anchor stable; long answer opened/closed; direct claim selection/application and phone reading-position navigation observed. Phone Contents remained above viewport, so blocked before taste-ready delivery.
parent_browser.fresh_transfer: Six-plant guide from outcome-only brief, explicit candidate reads, preserved actual raw-first source, zero repairs. Native/keyboard habitat and context navigation, settled phone containment and reduced-motion path observed; transient geometry unresolved.

native_image.use: Fine paper texture in isolated reader trial

limits: Synthetic evidence metadata does not establish UI/image truth.
Checker does not collect observations or authorize publication/taste acceptance.
Only five real cases are formally bound in the portfolio; further observed scopes are described separately. Other real cases remain incomplete.
Phone index failure and transient navigation geometry remain in frozen trial sources; no perfect-first-draft claim.
Full motion lifecycles, every optional component, physical devices, screen readers, natural triggering and cross-host behavioral parity remain unqualified.
No matched skill/no-skill quality result, neural-weight cause, backend image version or measured paid cost is claimed.

rollback.method: Restore the admitted frontend owner from its baseline ready source through scoped canonical reconciliation; do not reset unrelated work.
